etymology.historical_story: The spelling shan cannot support a reliable origin story by itself. A name, a foreign-language expression, and a transcription error can share the same letters while having unrelated histories. Here, the responsible lexicographic record preserves the supplied form and leaves its origin open until an original sentence, identifiable referent, or documented language source establishes what it represents.
